snippets.name: common db entereies
snippets.query:
SELECT id, common_db_uid, key, value
FROM public.common_db

snippets.name: calls count and sms count
snippets.query:
SELECT
  t.target_number,
  t.target_uid,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS number_of_sms,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS number_of_calls
FROM target AS t
LEFT JOIN sms AS s
  ON t.id = s.target_id
LEFT JOIN call AS c
  ON t.id = c.target_id
GROUP BY
  t.id,
  t.target_number,
  t.target_uid;

snippets.name: user analysis
snippets.query:
SELECT
  user_analysis.user_uid,
  user_analysis.user_name,
  SUM(user_analysis.total_ingested) AS total_ingested_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.total_success) AS total_success_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.total_failed) AS total_failed_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.total_validation_failed) AS total_validation_failed_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.total_calls) AS total_calls_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.total_sms) AS total_sms_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.total_duration_seconds) AS total_duration_seconds_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.total_suspicious_duration) AS total_suspicious_duration_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.call_critical) AS call_critical_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.call_high_critical) AS call_high_critical_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.call_mid_critical) AS call_mid_critical_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.call_low_critical) AS call_low_critical_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.call_not_critical) AS call_not_critical_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.sms_critical) AS sms_critical_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.sms_high_critical) AS sms_high_critical_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.sms_mid_critical) AS sms_mid_critical_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.sms_low_critical) AS sms_low_critical_sum,
  SUM(user_analysis.sms_not_critical) AS sms_not_critical_sum
FROM user_analysis
GROUP BY
  user_analysis.user_uid,
  user_analysis.user_name
ORDER BY
  user_analysis.user_name;

snippets.name: call analysis
snippets.query:
SELECT
  SUM(total_calls) AS total_calls_sum,
  SUM(total_ingested) AS total_ingested_sum,
  SUM(total_success) AS total_success_sum,
  SUM(total_failed) AS total_failed_sum,
  SUM(total_validation_failed) AS total_validation_failed_sum,
  SUM(total_duration_seconds) AS total_duration_seconds_sum,
  SUM(total_suspicious_duration) AS total_suspicious_duration_sum,
  SUM(total_critical) AS total_critical_sum,
  SUM(total_high_critical) AS total_high_critical_sum,
  SUM(total_mid_critical) AS total_mid_critical_sum,
  SUM(total_low_critical) AS total_low_critical_sum,
  SUM(total_not_critical) AS total_not_critical_sum
FROM call_analysis;

snippets.name: calls against target
snippets.query:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.call_uid,
  c.call_datetime,
  c.duration,
  c.type,
  c.category,
  c.criticality,
  c.comment,
  c.summary,
  c.audio_file,
  c.meta_file,
  c.target_id,
  c.call_read_status,
  c.call_endtime,
  c.start_location,
  c.end_location,
  c.is_active,
  c.created_at,
  c.created_by,
  c.updated_at,
  c.updated_by,
  c.concise_summary
FROM call AS c
JOIN target AS t
  ON c.target_id = t.id
WHERE
  t.target_number = '{target number}'
LIMIT 1000;
snippets.description: show all calls against the given target number

snippets.name: call hunt
snippets.query:
SELECT
  c.id,
  c.call_uid,
  c.call_datetime,
  c.duration,
  c.type,
  c.category,
  c.criticality,
  c.comment,
  c.summary,
  f.name AS audio_file_name,
  t.target_number,
  t.full_name AS target_full_name
FROM call AS c
JOIN file AS f
  ON c.audio_file = f.id
JOIN target AS t
  ON c.target_id = t.id
WHERE
  f.name = '{filename}' AND t.target_number = '{target number}';
snippets.description: search a call using its file name and target number

snippets.name: find call by id
snippets.query:
SELECT
  c.id AS call_id,
  c.call_uid,
  c.call_datetime,
  c.duration,
  c.type AS call_type,
  c.category AS call_category,
  c.criticality AS call_criticality,
  c.comment AS call_comment,
  c.summary AS call_summary,
  c.call_read_status,
  c.call_endtime,
  c.start_location,
  c.end_location,
  c.is_active AS call_is_active,
  c.created_at AS call_created_at,
  c.updated_at AS call_updated_at,
  c.concise_summary,

  t.target_uid,
  t.code AS target_code,
  t.target_number,
  t.full_name AS target_full_name,
  t.aliases AS target_aliases,
  t.category AS target_category,
  t.description AS target_description,
  t.user_details AS target_user_details,
  t.risk_priority AS target_risk_priority,
  t.is_marked AS target_is_marked,
  t.is_active_monitoring AS target_is_active_monitoring,

  af.name AS audio_file_name,
  af.file_path AS audio_file_path,
  af.size AS audio_file_size,
  mf.name AS meta_file_name,
  mf.file_path AS meta_file_path,
  mf.size AS meta_file_size,

  cpi.diarization_model_version,
  cpi.transcription_model_version,
  cpi.translation_model_version,
  cpi.voice_matching_model_version,
  cpi.language AS processing_language,
  cpi.processed_at,
  cpi.target_keywords_new AS processing_target_keywords_new,
  cpi.global_keywords_new AS processing_global_keywords_new,
  cpi.target_keywords AS processing_target_keywords,
  cpi.global_keywords AS processing_global_keywords,
  cpi.language_confidence,

  COALESCE(sc.active_segment_count, 0) AS active_segment_count,
  COALESCE(sc.inactive_segment_count, 0) AS inactive_segment_count
FROM call AS c
LEFT JOIN target AS t
  ON c.target_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN file AS af
  ON c.audio_file = af.id
LEFT JOIN file AS mf
  ON c.meta_file = mf.id
LEFT JOIN call_processing_information AS cpi
  ON c.id = cpi.call_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    gs.call_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gs.is_active = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS active_segment_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gs.is_active = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS inactive_segment_count
  FROM generated_segment_information AS gs
  WHERE
    gs.call_id = 4556
  GROUP BY
    gs.call_id
) AS sc
  ON c.id = sc.call_id
WHERE
  c.id = {callid}
LIMIT 1000;
